Q: How to configure python virtual environment with different python version? A:

Reason

You're trying to use a package of one Python version with another, and that causes a conflict.

Solution

Install virtualenv on the version you want to use it with and call the interpreter of that version directly.

Windows

py -3.10 -m virtualenv

Linux

python3.10 -m virtualenv

Q: XAPK File Validation Failed - APK Expansion Files A:

Here is how you need to get it done

1) You can put your images in any custom named folder you want. e.g myimages.

2) put all those images in a zip archive, once done adding rename that archive to main.versioncode.package-name.obb

3) Place that .obb file in directory sdcar/Android/obb/package-name/main.versioncode.package-name.obb

Hope it helps
